summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #351, then switch to the docs/phase-21-context branch, push it, and merge in the latest main.
summary.outcome: All 4 review threads were marked not applicable and resolved without code changes; the docs/phase-21-context branch was pushed and merged with main after resolving a conflict in ROADMAP.md.

repo: TypeORM's QueryFailedError copies all driverError properties onto the error instance itself via ObjectUtils.assign, so error.code === '23505' is correct and error.driverError.code is not required.
The project uses Prettier for formatting; both vault.service.ts and vault.service.spec.ts pass prettier --check, making trailing-comma suggestions from automated reviewers invalid.
GitHub Copilot's automated review comments on this repo have been unreliable — all 4 suggestions on PR #351 were based on incorrect assumptions about TypeORM internals or Prettier config.
The project is organized as a monorepo with apps (api, desktop, web), packages (core, crypto, sdk, api-client), and tests directories, managed with pnpm.

code.finding: error.code === '23505' works correctly because TypeORM QueryFailedError spreads driverError properties onto itself; no need to access error.driverError.code.
Test mock sets code: '23505' directly on the error object, which correctly mirrors actual TypeORM runtime behavior.
Merge conflict arose between main (phase 20 marked complete) and docs/phase-21-context (phase 21 entry added); resolved by keeping main's phase 20 status and HEAD's phase 21 row.

workflow: When automated reviewer comments conflict with observed runtime behavior, verify by inspecting the dependency source (node_modules) directly rather than trusting the suggestion.
GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation can batch multiple thread resolutions; REST endpoint requires integer comment ID via --field (not -f) for in_reply_to.
gh api graphql is the correct tool for fetching PR review thread resolution status, as the REST API does not expose isResolved.

friction: TypeORM source had to be located manually inside a deeply nested pnpm virtual store path to verify the driverError property-spreading behavior.
Prettier had to be invoked from the apps/api directory (not repo root) to correctly pick up the local config.
Merge conflict in ROADMAP.md required manual resolution before the merge could be committed.
